newsitem.title: MEXICO: Gfesa up sharply on BT deal.
newsitem.headline: Gfesa up sharply on BT deal.

text.p: Shares listed by Mexican publishers Grupo Fernandez Editores (Gfesa) were sharply up in midday trade on Tuesday following news that a Bankers Trust New York Corp subsidiary had become a minority shareholder in the company.

"Yes, it was announced today, although it is still subject to approval by the National Banking and Securities Commission," Daniel Couttolenc, head of corporate banking at Bankers Trust in Mexico, told Reuters.
Gfesa B class shares were up 16 centavos to 1.68 pesos, and 3.05 million shares had been traded.

Gfesa announced on Monday that BT International (Delaware), a subsidiary of Bankers Trust, had acquired 107.1 million pesos of C class shares through "a novel capital-raising scheme using convertible and redeemable shares."
Gfesa lists A and B class shares in Mexico.
"These (the C class) are special shares for the transaction, and are obviously not in circulation," Coulenc added.
